verification.method: Downloaded each selected release asset, verified SHA256 against both release checksums and GitHub asset digest, and listed/read archive members without executing binaries. Dependency archives were checked against the pinned lock/module checksums. No upstream install, build or postinstall scripts were executed.
verification.dependency_scope: Exact upstream release dependency lock/module supersets, including build, test and target-specific entries; no claim that every dependency is linked into each executable. No source scripts executed.
verification.upstream_binary_source_equivalence: Not independently reproduced or attested by Mirket.
verification.license_coverage: Preserved discovered source and runtime root notices. A machine-generated dependency source superset is not a platform-specific linked-binary bill of materials or legal attestation.
verification.runtime_notice_limit: The language runtime root notices are included. Runtime build identifiers do not by themselves establish complete platform system-library redistribution requirements.
